```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 8. GRÁFICO DE BARRAS METACYC EN ESPAÑOL
# Protocolo: Barras MetaCyc HUMAnN3
# Modo: reproducibilidad estricta
# ============================================================

# Objetivo:
# 1. Recuperar los datos preparados en el Bloque 7.
# 2. Generar gráfico de barras por categoría funcional y desierto.
# 3. Mostrar media ± error estándar de la abundancia total por muestra.
# 4. Añadir asteriscos de significancia usando los p.adj del Bloque 4.
# 5. Guardar JPG, PNG y PDF.
#
# Importante:
# - No se recalcula Wilcoxon.
# - No se recalculan p-valores.
# - No se cambian transformaciones.
# - No se cambian umbrales.
# - Las barras representan variación entre muestras biológicas:
#   9 muestras CC y 9 muestras VG por categoría.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# 8.1 Rutas y objeto del Bloque 7 ------------------------------------------

BASE_DIR <- "/Users/ale/Desktop/HUMAnN3"
PROJECT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "MetaCyc_violins_reproducible")

block7_objects_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "objects",
  "07_barplot_data_preparation.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(block7_objects_file)) {
  stop("No se encontró el objeto del Bloque 7. Corre primero el Bloque 7.")
}

block7 <- readRDS(block7_objects_file)

bar_summary_es <- block7$bar_summary_es
bar_significance_es <- block7$bar_significance_es
orden_categorias_es <- block7$orden_categorias_es
colores_desierto <- block7$colores_desierto

log_file <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "logs", "bitacora_automatica.tsv")

log_step <- function(bloque, accion, decision_tecnica, razon, resultado = "OK") {
  entrada <- tibble(
    timestamp = as.character(Sys.time()),
    bloque = bloque,
    accion = accion,
    decision_tecnica = decision_tecnica,
    razon = razon,
    resultado = resultado
  )
  readr::write_tsv(entrada, log_file, append = TRUE)
}

log_step(
  bloque = "Bloque 8",
  accion = "Inicio de gráfico de barras en español",
  decision_tecnica = "Usar resumen media ± error estándar generado en Bloque 7",
  razon = "Graficar abundancia total por categoría funcional considerando variación entre muestras biológicas.",
  resultado = "Objeto del Bloque 7 recuperado correctamente"
)

# 8.2 Validaciones de entrada ----------------------------------------------

required_bar_cols <- c(
  "Categoría",
  "Desierto",
  "n_muestras",
  "mean_abundance",
  "sd_abundance",
  "se_abundance",
  "p.adj",
  "Significancia"
)

required_sig_cols <- c(
  "Categoría",
  "ymax",
  "y_position",
  "label"
)

if (!all(required_bar_cols %in% colnames(bar_summary_es))) {
  stop("bar_summary_es no contiene todas las columnas necesarias.")
}

if (!all(required_sig_cols %in% colnames(bar_significance_es))) {
  stop("bar_significance_es no contiene todas las columnas necesarias.")
}

if (nrow(bar_summary_es) != 36) {
  stop("bar_summary_es debe tener 36 filas: 18 categorías x 2 desiertos.")
}

if (nrow(bar_significance_es) != 18) {
  stop("bar_significance_es debe tener 18 filas: una por categoría.")
}

if (!all(bar_summary_es$n_muestras == 9)) {
  stop("Cada categoría-desierto debe tener 9 muestras.")
}

# 8.3 Preparar factores y etiquetas ----------------------------------------

bar_summary_es <- bar_summary_es %>%
  mutate(
    Categoría = factor(Categoría, levels = orden_categorias_es),
    Desierto = factor(Desierto, levels = c("CC", "VG"))
  )

bar_significance_es <- bar_significance_es %>%
  mutate(
    Categoría = factor(Categoría, levels = orden_categorias_es)
  )

# Para evitar textos vacíos innecesarios
bar_significance_plot_es <- bar_significance_es %>%
  filter(label != "")

# 8.4 Diagnóstico del gráfico ----------------------------------------------

barplot_diagnostics_es <- tibble(
  diagnostic_item = c(
    "Número de categorías",
    "Número de desiertos",
    "Número de filas en bar_summary_es",
    "Número de categorías con asterisco",
    "Barras representan",
    "Error bars representan",
    "Estadística usada para asteriscos",
    "Corrección por múltiples comparaciones",
    "Umbral de significancia"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(length(unique(bar_summary_es$Categoría))),
    as.character(length(unique(bar_summary_es$Desierto))),
    as.character(nrow(bar_summary_es)),
    as.character(nrow(bar_significance_plot_es)),
    "Media de abundancia total por categoría funcional por muestra",
    "Error estándar de la media",
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum test del Bloque 4",
    "Benjamini-Hochberg FDR",
    "p.adj < 0.05"
  )
)

barplot_diagnostics_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "qc",
  "08_barplot_diagnostics_spanish.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(barplot_diagnostics_es, barplot_diagnostics_file)

cat("\nDiagnóstico del gráfico de barras en español:\n")
print(barplot_diagnostics_es)

# 8.5 Crear gráfico de barras en español -----------------------------------

fig_bar_es <- ggplot(
  bar_summary_es,
  aes(
    x = Desierto,
    y = mean_abundance,
    fill = Desierto
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.72,
    color = "gray25",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(mean_abundance - se_abundance, 0),
      ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance
    ),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "gray20"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bar_significance_plot_es,
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_position,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colores_desierto
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Categoría,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Desierto",
    y = "Abundancia total promedio por categoría",
    caption = "Barras = media por muestra; líneas = error estándar. Asteriscos = Wilcoxon con corrección FDR-BH."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10,
      lineheight = 0.95
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 18,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 18,
      margin = margin(r = 12)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 13,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.20),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.32),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.05, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(14, 14, 14, 14)
  )

print(fig_bar_es)

# 8.6 Guardar figura -------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 8B. GRÁFICO DE BARRAS EN INGLÉS, FORMATO PUBLICACIÓN
# Formato: categorías en eje X + barras agrupadas CC/VG
# ============================================================

# Objetivo:
# 1. Generar gráfico de barras como la figura de referencia:
#    - Categorías funcionales en eje X
#    - Barras agrupadas por desierto: CC y VG
#    - Asteriscos de significancia sobre cada categoría
#    - Sin facetas
#    - Texto en inglés
#    - Calidad de publicación
#
# 2. Mantener:
#    - mismos datos preparados en Bloque 7
#    - mismas medias ± error estándar
#    - mismos p.adj del Bloque 4
#    - mismos umbrales de significancia
#
# Este bloque NO recalcula Wilcoxon.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
})

# 8B.1 Rutas y objetos -----------------------------------------------------

BASE_DIR <- "/Users/ale/Desktop/HUMAnN3"
PROJECT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "MetaCyc_violins_reproducible")

block7_objects_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "objects",
  "07_barplot_data_preparation.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(block7_objects_file)) {
  stop("No se encontró el objeto del Bloque 7. Corre primero el Bloque 7.")
}

block7 <- readRDS(block7_objects_file)

bar_summary_es <- block7$bar_summary_es
bar_significance_es <- block7$bar_significance_es
orden_categorias_es <- block7$orden_categorias_es
colores_desierto <- block7$colores_desierto

log_file <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "logs", "bitacora_automatica.tsv")

log_step <- function(bloque, accion, decision_tecnica, razon, resultado = "OK") {
  entrada <- tibble(
    timestamp = as.character(Sys.time()),
    bloque = bloque,
    accion = accion,
    decision_tecnica = decision_tecnica,
    razon = razon,
    resultado = resultado
  )
  readr::write_tsv(entrada, log_file, append = TRUE)
}

log_step(
  bloque = "Bloque 8B",
  accion = "Inicio de gráfico de barras en inglés estilo publicación",
  decision_tecnica = "Usar barras agrupadas por desierto con categorías funcionales en eje X",
  razon = "Reproducir el formato de la figura de referencia en inglés y con calidad para revista científica.",
  resultado = "Objeto del Bloque 7 recuperado correctamente"
)

# 8B.2 Diccionario de traducción -------------------------------------------

category_translation <- tibble(
  Categoría = c(
    "Metabolismo del azufre",
    "Estrés oxidativo y respuesta ambiental",
    "Aminoácidos: degradación",
    "Metabolismo del fósforo",
    "Otras funciones / sin clasificar",
    "Protección UV",
    "Aminoácidos: biosíntesis",
    "Nucleótidos",
    "Biofilm y adhesión",
    "Respiración y transporte de electrones",
    "Polisacáridos y pared celular",
    "Fermentación",
    "Vitaminas y cofactores",
    "Metabolismo del nitrógeno",
    "Metabolismo de compuestos aromáticos",
    "Fotosíntesis y pigmentos",
    "Metabolismo del metano y C1",
    "Glucólisis y metabolismo central"
  ),
  Functional_category = c(
    "Sulfur metabolism",
    "Oxidative stress and environmental response",
    "Amino acid degradation",
    "Phosphorus metabolism",
    "Other or unclassified functions",
    "UV protection",
    "Amino acid biosynthesis",
    "Nucleotides",
    "Biofilm and adhesion",
    "Respiration and electron transport",
    "Cell wall and polysaccharides",
    "Fermentation",
    "Vitamins and cofactors",
    "Nitrogen metabolism",
    "Aromatic compound metabolism",
    "Photosynthesis and pigments",
    "Methane and C1 metabolism",
    "Glycolysis and central metabolism"
  )
)

# Orden tipo figura: categorías en una sola línea horizontal.
# Aquí se usa orden alfabético en inglés para que sea legible y estándar.
# Si prefieres el mismo orden de los violines, cambia sort(...) por orden_categorias_en.

orden_categorias_en <- category_translation %>%
  pull(Functional_category) %>%
  sort()

# 8B.3 Preparar tabla para barras ------------------------------------------

bar_summary_en <- bar_summary_es %>%
  left_join(category_translation, by = "Categoría") %>%
  mutate(
    Functional_category = factor(
      Functional_category,
      levels = orden_categorias_en
    ),
    Desert = factor(
      Desierto,
      levels = c("CC", "VG")
    )
  )

bar_significance_en <- bar_significance_es %>%
  left_join(category_translation, by = "Categoría") %>%
  mutate(
    Functional_category = factor(
      Functional_category,
      levels = orden_categorias_en
    ),
    label = case_when(
      p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

bar_significance_plot_en <- bar_significance_en %>%
  filter(label != "")

# Posición vertical común para asteriscos por categoría
# Se usa la media + error estándar más alta dentro de cada categoría.

bar_significance_plot_en <- bar_summary_en %>%
  group_by(Functional_category) %>%
  summarise(
    y_position = max(mean_abundance + se_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bar_significance_en %>%
      select(Functional_category, p.adj, label),
    by = "Functional_category"
  ) %>%
  filter(label != "")

# 8B.4 Guardar tablas usadas para la figura --------------------------------

bar_summary_en_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "tables",
  "08B_barplot_summary_english_publication.tsv"

bar_significance_en_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "tables",
  "08B_barplot_significance_english_publication.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(bar_summary_en, bar_summary_en_file)
readr::write_tsv(bar_significance_plot_en, bar_significance_en_file)

cat("\nResumen usado para gráfico de barras en inglés:\n")
print(bar_summary_en)

cat("\nAsteriscos usados para gráfico de barras en inglés:\n")
print(bar_significance_plot_en)

# 8B.5 Diagnóstico ---------------------------------------------------------

barplot_diagnostics_en <- tibble(
  diagnostic_item = c(
    "Number of functional categories",
    "Number of deserts",
    "Rows in bar_summary_en",
    "Bars represent",
    "Error bars represent",
    "Significance labels represent",
    "Statistical test",
    "Multiple-testing correction",
    "Significance threshold",
    "Wilcoxon recalculated in this block"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(length(unique(bar_summary_en$Functional_category))),
    as.character(length(unique(bar_summary_en$Desert))),
    as.character(nrow(bar_summary_en)),
    "Mean total MetaCyc reaction abundance per sample",
    "Standard error of the mean",
    "Adjusted p-value significance codes from Block 4",
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum test",
    "Benjamini-Hochberg FDR",
    "Adjusted p-value < 0.05",
    "No"
  )
)

barplot_diagnostics_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "qc",
  "08B_barplot_diagnostics_english_publication.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(barplot_diagnostics_en, barplot_diagnostics_file)

cat("\nDiagnóstico del gráfico de barras en inglés:\n")
print(barplot_diagnostics_en)

# 8B.6 Gráfico de barras en inglés -----------------------------------------

# Nota:
# Se mantiene fondo limpio, fuente grande, etiquetas rotadas y leyenda lateral.
# El título se deja como título interno, similar a la figura de referencia.
# Para manuscrito final, también puedes quitar el título y dejarlo solo en el caption.

fig_bar_en_publication <- ggplot(

  aes(
    x = Functional_category,

    fill = Desert
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),

    color = "gray25",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.90
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(mean_abundance - se_abundance, 0),
      ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "gray20"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bar_significance_plot_en,
    aes(
      x = Functional_category,
      y = y_position,
      label = label
    ),
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 9. CIERRE DEL PROTOCOLO Y REPORTE DE REPRODUCIBILIDAD
# Protocolo: MetaCyc abundance violins and barplots
# Modo: reproducibilidad estricta
# ============================================================

# Objetivo:
# 1. Cerrar formalmente el protocolo.
# 2. Registrar archivos usados.
# 3. Registrar pasos ejecutados.
# 4. Registrar validaciones disponibles.
# 5. Registrar figuras y tablas generadas.
# 6. Guardar sessionInfo().
# 7. Crear un reporte final en TXT y TSV.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})

# 9.1 Rutas principales ----------------------------------------------------

BASE_DIR <- "/Users/ale/Desktop/HUMAnN3"
PROJECT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "MetaCyc_violins_reproducible")

log_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "logs",
  "bitacora_automatica.tsv"
)

log_step <- function(bloque, accion, decision_tecnica, razon, resultado = "OK") {
  entrada <- tibble(
    timestamp = as.character(Sys.time()),
    bloque = bloque,
    accion = accion,
    decision_tecnica = decision_tecnica,
    razon = razon,
    resultado = resultado
  )
  readr::write_tsv(entrada, log_file, append = TRUE)
}

log_step(
  bloque = "Bloque 9",
  accion = "Cierre del protocolo",
  decision_tecnica = "Crear reporte final de reproducibilidad",
  razon = "Documentar archivos usados, pasos ejecutados, validaciones, salidas y ambiente de R.",
  resultado = "Inicio correcto"
)

# 9.2 Leer archivos seleccionados ------------------------------------------

selected_files_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "metadata",
  "00B_selected_input_files.tsv"
)

if (file.exists(selected_files_file)) {
  selected_files <- readr::read_tsv(
    selected_files_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  selected_files <- tibble(
    warning = "No se encontró 00B_selected_input_files.tsv"
  )
}

# 9.3 Leer bitácora --------------------------------------------------------

if (file.exists(log_file)) {
  bitacora <- readr::read_tsv(
    log_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  bitacora <- tibble(
    warning = "No se encontró bitácora automática"
  )
}

# 9.4 Compilar validaciones ------------------------------------------------

validation_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "qc"),
  pattern = "validaciones|validaciones_|_validaciones",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

validation_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  validation_files,
  function(x) {
    tabla <- readr::read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if (!"resultado" %in% colnames(tabla)) {
      return(
        tibble(
          validation_file = basename(x),
          n_validations = NA_integer_,
          n_TRUE = NA_integer_,
          n_FALSE = NA_integer_,
          all_TRUE = NA
        )
      )
    }
    
    tibble(
      validation_file = basename(x),
      n_validations = nrow(tabla),
      n_TRUE = sum(tabla$resultado == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_FALSE = sum(tabla$resultado == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
      all_TRUE = all(tabla$resultado == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)

validation_summary_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "qc",
  "09_final_validation_summary.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(validation_summary, validation_summary_file)

# 9.5 Registrar figuras generadas ------------------------------------------

figure_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|pdf|tiff)$",
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

figure_registry <- tibble(
  file = figure_files,
  file_name = basename(figure_files),
  folder = dirname(figure_files),
  extension = tools::file_ext(figure_files),
  file_size_bytes = as.numeric(file.info(figure_files)$size),
  md5 = as.character(tools::md5sum(figure_files))
)

figure_registry_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "qc",
  "09_final_figure_registry.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(figure_registry, figure_registry_file)

# 9.6 Registrar tablas generadas -------------------------------------------

table_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "tables"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.(tsv|csv)$",
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

statistics_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "statistics"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.(tsv|csv)$",
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

all_table_files <- c(table_files, statistics_files)

table_registry <- tibble(
  file = all_table_files,
  file_name = basename(all_table_files),
  folder = dirname(all_table_files),
  extension = tools::file_ext(all_table_files),
  file_size_bytes = as.numeric(file.info(all_table_files)$size),
  md5 = as.character(tools::md5sum(all_table_files))
)

table_registry_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "qc",
  "09_final_table_registry.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(table_registry, table_registry_file)

# 9.7 Guardar sessionInfo --------------------------------------------------

session_info_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "metadata",
  "09_final_sessionInfo.txt"
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  session_info_file
)

# 9.8 Crear resumen final del protocolo ------------------------------------

final_summary <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Project directory",
    "Base directory",
    "Main MetaCyc input",
    "Protocol status",
    "Main data table",
    "Main transformations",
    "Statistical test",
    "Multiple-testing correction",
    "Significance threshold",
    "Main Spanish violin figure",
    "Main English violin figure",
    "Main English barplot original metric",
    "English barplot with statistical legend",
    "Validation summary",
    "Figure registry",
    "Table registry",
    "Session information",
    "Automatic log"
  ),
  value = c(
    PROJECT_DIR,
    BASE_DIR,
    if ("selected_path" %in% colnames(selected_files)) {
      selected_files %>%
        filter(filename == "rxn-cpm-metacyc.tsv") %>%
        pull(selected_path)
    } else {
      "Not available"
    },
    "Completed",
    "rxn-cpm-metacyc.tsv",
    "Removal of internal Sample/Type rows; sample renaming; functional category assignment by keyword matching; long-format abundance table",
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum test by functional category",
    "Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction",
    "Adjusted p-value < 0.05",
    file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "spanish_exact", "05_violin_abundancia_por_categoria_espanol.pdf"),
    file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "06B_violin_metacyc_functional_categories_PUBLICATION_FINAL.tiff"),
    file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "08D_barplot_original_metric_english_no_title.tiff"),
    file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "08E_barplot_original_metric_with_statistics_legend_no_title.tiff"),
    validation_summary_file,
    figure_registry_file,
    table_registry_file,
    session_info_file,
    log_file
  )
)

final_summary_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "docs",
  "09_final_reproducibility_summary.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(final_summary, final_summary_file)

# 9.9 Crear reporte final en texto -----------------------------------------

final_report_txt <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "docs",
  "09_final_reproducibility_report.txt"
)

report_lines <- c(
  "FINAL REPRODUCIBILITY REPORT",
  "MetaCyc abundance violins and barplots",
  "============================================================",
  "",
  paste0("Date: ", Sys.time()),
  paste0("Project directory: ", PROJECT_DIR),
  paste0("Base directory: ", BASE_DIR),
  "",
  "Protocol status: COMPLETED",
  "",
  "Main input:",
  if ("selected_path" %in% colnames(selected_files)) {
    selected_files %>%
      filter(filename == "rxn-cpm-metacyc.tsv") %>%
      pull(selected_path)
  } else {
    "Input file registry not available"
  },
  "",
  "Main analytical decisions:",
  "- The MetaCyc reaction abundance table rxn-cpm-metacyc.tsv was used as the main input.",
  "- Internal HUMAnN3 rows Sample and Type were removed, following the original protocol.",
  "- Samples were renamed to biological sample identifiers ending in _CC or _VG.",
  "- Functional categories were assigned using keyword-based matching of MetaCyc reaction names.",
  "- Wilcoxon rank-sum tests were performed by functional category.",
  "- P-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction.",
  "- Significance was defined as adjusted p-value < 0.05.",
  "- Barplot version 8D reproduces the original metric: mean(Abundancia) by functional category and desert.",
  "- Barplot version 8E adds an explicit statistical legend for publication.",
  "",
  "Key output figures:",
  paste0("- Spanish violin figure: ", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "spanish_exact", "05_violin_abundancia_por_categoria_espanol.pdf")),
  paste0("- English publication violin figure: ", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "06B_violin_metacyc_functional_categories_PUBLICATION_FINAL.tiff")),
  paste0("- English barplot original metric: ", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "08D_barplot_original_metric_english_no_title.tiff")),
  paste0("- English barplot with statistical legend: ", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures", "english_publication", "08E_barplot_original_metric_with_statistics_legend_no_title.tiff")),
  "",
  "Documentation files:",
  paste0("- Final validation summary: ", validation_summary_file),
  paste0("- Final figure registry: ", figure_registry_file),
  paste0("- Final table registry: ", table_registry_file),
  paste0("- Session information: ", session_info_file),
  paste0("- Automatic log: ", log_file),
  "",
  "Validation overview:",

    "- Validation files detected: ",

  ),

  ),
  paste0(
    "- Validation files with at least one FALSE: ",
    sum(validation_summary$all_TRUE == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  "",
  "End of protocol."
)

writeLines(report_lines, final_report_txt)

# 9.10 Guardar objeto final RDS --------------------------------------------

final_object_file <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "results",
  "objects",
  "09_final_reproducibility_report.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    selected_files = selected_files,
    bitacora = bitacora,

    figure_registry = figure_registry,
    table_registry = table_registry,
    final_summary = final_summary,
    report_lines = report_lines
  ),
  final_object_file
)

# 9.11 Validaciones del cierre ---------------------------------------------
```
